newsitem.title: USA: Santa Anita Cos ammends plan.
newsitem.headline: Santa Anita Cos ammends plan.

text.p: The Santa Anita Cos said Thursday it has revised its recently announced transaction with real estate investment firm Colony Capital Inc.

The ammendment restructures Colony's purchase of 8 percent of Santa Anita's outstanding paired shares to ensure that it meets stock exchange listing requirements. Under the plan Colony will invest approximately $138 million into Santa Anita.

Under the revised terms, Santa Anita will issue to Colony 112,700 paired common shares, or about 1 percent of the companies' paired common shares outstanding, and 867,343 redeemable paired preferred shares.
After shareholders approve the plan the preferred stock will be exchangeable on a one-to-one basis for Santa Anita paired share common stock.
